title: 第280章 百胜之约第279章 邀请
slug: 转世成女开局攻略气运之子
content_zh:
见林尘表情没有丝毫变化，涂林当即继续道：
“当然，我涂某自是不会让林兄弟白出力。
只要林兄弟能帮我度过这个难关，罗刹城里的资源，任凭你随便挑选，不管是元晶、丹药、还是高阶武技，
我涂林绝不含糊。”
林尘并未着急答应，而是垂眸沉思一番。
毕竟他早已不是什么初出茅庐的傻小子，对方既是愿意开出这等条件，便说明用妖火洗练血脉一事，没那么简单。
于是，林尘当即试探道：
“涂城主，借妖火洗练血脉，可不是个轻松的活儿。
稍有不慎，你我恐都会被妖火反噬，烧成灰烬。”
林尘虽不知其中后果，但他墨玉之中，赤云却是略知一二。
所以在赤云的辅助下，林尘故意把事情说得严重些，“所以，涂城主何以觉得，我会为了这点资源，去冒如此大的风险？”
涂林笑了。
他似乎早就料到林尘会这么说。
所以十分干脆的顺势说道：
“林兄弟莫急，资源只是其一。”
涂林沉声继续：“我尚还有一个请求。
如果林兄弟能答应，并且做到，那才是真正的大头。”
“说来听听。”林尘挑眉，用以掩饰心底惊讶。
显然也是未曾料到，眼前之人，竟是不按套路出牌。
“我要你……赢下生死斗。”

涂林脸上的笑意收敛，神色一时变得无比郑重。
林尘有些不解：“这不用你说。
我来就是为了打擂台的，自然要赢。”
“林兄弟误会了，我说的赢，不是赢个十场八场。”
涂林盯着林尘的眼睛，一字一顿道，“我要你打满百场，
拿下罗刹城的最终奖励。”
林尘愣了一下。
早先他倒是听赤云，也提过这个百胜奖励，
但他还不知道具体是什么。
“百胜？”
林尘皱起眉头，“这罗刹城的生死斗，想来应该没有那么容易。”
“自然不容易，罗刹城中生死斗创立至今，能打满百胜者，屈指可数。”
涂林长叹一声，却是冷声道：“但这次有所不同，百胜之人，可从城中密库里，取走至宝。
密库里的那件至宝，自是不能落入外人手中。”
content_en:
Seeing that Lin Chen's expression did not change at all, Tu Lin immediately continued:
“Of course, I, Tu, will not let Brother Lin’s efforts go in vain.
As long as Brother Lin can help me overcome this difficulty, you can choose the resources in Rakshasa City at your will, whether it is Yuan Jing, elixirs, or high-level martial arts.
I, Tu Lin, am absolutely unambiguous. "
Lin Chen did not agree in a hurry, but lowered his eyes and thought deeply.
After all, he is no longer just a young boy. Since the other party is willing to offer such conditions, it means that using demon fire to cleanse the bloodline is not that simple.
Therefore, Lin Chen immediately tried and said:
"City Lord Tu, using demon fire to cleanse your bloodline is not an easy job.
If you're not careful, you and I may be backfired by the demonic fire and burned to ashes. "
Although Lin Chen didn't know the consequences, Chi Yun, among his fellow Mo Yus, knew a little bit about it.
So with Chi Yun's help, Lin Chen deliberately made the matter more serious, "So, why does City Master Tu think that I would take such a big risk for such a small amount of resources?"
Tu Lin smiled.
He seemed to have expected that Lin Chen would say this.
So he said very simply:
"Brother Lin, don't worry, resources are only one of them."
Tu Lin continued in a deep voice: "I have one more request.
If Brother Lin can agree and do it, then he will be the real boss. "
"Tell me about it." Lin Chen raised his eyebrows to hide his surprise.
Obviously, he had not expected that the person in front of him would not play according to the routine.
"I want you to...win the fight to the death."
The smile on Tu Lin's face faded, and his expression became extremely solemn for a moment.
Lin Chen was a little puzzled: "You don't need to say this.
I came here just to compete in the ring, so naturally I want to win. "
"Brother Lin misunderstood. When I said win, I didn't mean win eight out of ten games."
Tu Lin stared into Lin Chen's eyes and said word by word, "I want you to fight a hundred games.
Win the final reward of Rakshasa City. "
Lin Chen was stunned for a moment.
Earlier, he had heard from Chi Yun that he also mentioned this Yum reward.
But he doesn't know what exactly yet.
"Yum?"
Lin Chen frowned, "This life and death battle in Rakshasa City shouldn't be that easy."
"Of course it's not easy. Since the creation of the life-and-death battle in Rakshasa City, there are only a handful of people who can win it."
Tu Lin sighed, but said in a cold voice: "But this time it is different. The one who is victorious can take the treasure from the secret vault in the city.
The treasure in the secret vault cannot fall into the hands of outsiders. "
